authorization: Latest user task explicitly authorizes one final offline empirical confirmation, including negative outcomes; supersedes old DO_NOT_RUN conditional gate only for this bounded confirmation. No online M3.

scientific_hypotheses.RQ1: Action conditioning may reduce weighted state error vs pooled affine and identity; all6 contrasts reported. No contraction/global convergence claim.
scientific_hypotheses.RQ2: E may improve AP/Brier vs C nonlinear+history, N same-width norms and P random reassignment; full identical architecture with same1e-7 numerical tolerance.
scientific_hypotheses.RQ3: E may improve offline selected branch gain vs C,N,P. Action changes, corrections/disruptions, fixed actions and sample oracle reported. No online performance claim.
scientific_hypotheses.work_window: Frozen atomic-trained models transferred unchanged to480 real requests; sensitivity test, not calibrated480 predictors or budget controller.

statistics.primary_family: joint12Holm: atomic EvsC/N/P times AP,Brier,selected_gain9; equal480 EvsC/N/P selected_gain3
statistics.dynamics_family: separate6Holm: GA/LS/VND conditioned vs pooled/identity state-error reductions
statistics.unit: paired instance mean, with20 trajectories per instance; exact two-sided signed-rank; marginal hierarchical instance->paired trajectory bootstrap intervals
statistics.positive_benefit: No stable independent benefit unless EvsC gain mean>0, marginal95%CI lower>0, Holm p<.05; allcontrols,instanceheterogeneity andwindowscope retained.
statistics.null_interpretation: Failure to establish advantage is not equivalence or universal FP invalidity; no equivalence margin invented after results.

fairness: Same actions/components/decision opportunities;480 is real requested evaluations includingcachehits, no padding. Natural calls/caps/queries/decodes/time retained. Equalrequests is not equaltime/decodes.
source_scope: Full starting populations; all endpoint best schedules independently checkable; full GA endpoint population not archived. No claim of independent reconstruction of its other endpoint coordinates.
failure_rules: All20 instances/all20runindices/allstates/allactions retained. No outcome-based deletion, rerun, retuning or replacement. Partial/corrupt result aborts with preserved failure; engineering-only amendments must be separately documented; no inference from incomplete grid.
no_feedback: Detached outcomes never alter main trajectory or frozen model. Final outcomes may not select configuration, reward, features or metric.

cost_estimate_before_collection.expected_wall: about3-10minutes with12workers, conservative30minutes; an estimate, not a measured cost

second_implementation: Interface audit not executed as science; direct mechanism evidence remains one Python implementation.
